Test these items: execute a ViewDefinition and return tabular rows, simple Patient and Observation example views, unrolling arrays such as Patient.address into row sets, filtered Observation/resource views, column type coercion into DuckDB result columns, official SQL-on-FHIR v2 spec_tests parity at 144 tests (FHIR/sql-on-fhir.js snapshot as of 2026-08-11; re-sync per fhir4ds-private/docs/release-checklist.md before each release), parser, generator, and DuckDB execution agree for supported examples. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.
